question: Alcohol makes you feel warm. So why does your body actually get colder?
answer: Alcohol widens your blood vessels, so more blood flows to the skin. That feels cosy, but the skin is giving heat away, so your core temperature drops. In extreme cases this leads to hypothermia.
move: The warm glow of alcohol is heat leaving your body.
